integrity: Standalone exact verifier accompanies a universal combinatorial proof and transfer-matrix asymptotic argument; finite tests alone do not establish infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: All sites occupied; two colors; strictly mutually improving swaps; homogeneous neighborhood fraction; fixed cycle topology. Gaussian welfare concerns uniform stable colorings across unrestricted color counts, not equilibrium-selection dynamics.
title: Exact equilibrium census and Gaussian welfare law for two-color swap Schelling games on cycles
